additional_info.subject: Large Power Consumption on Idle
additional_info.body:

Good day.

Product: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset: MP/R4 170001840 and MP/R4170001683
Thank you.
Best Regards

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0452851-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP/R4 170001840 & MP/R4170001683] Power Consumption Issue CRM:03056000045
additional_info.body:
Good evening Eng Kia,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0452851.
As I understood, you are asking for support to further configure the Sleep Mode on #2 SichargeD units, and that the Power Save mode is already activated from the Plugz Backend from 00:00 to 06:00, by setting the OCPP parameter "PowerSavingModeSchedule".
Unfortunately, it is not supported the scheduling of power saving mode from day to day.
For your information, our SichargeD now can also support a reactive power compensation (RPC) function, where a converter of the type R100040G4 must be installed. RPC minimizes the consumed reactive power in standby by reducing the harmonic reactive power (QH) of the ground wave at 50/60 Hz. Through RPC, the active power consumption in standby is increased.
Please let me know if further information on PowerSaving Mode are required.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you!
With kind regards,

additional_info.body:
Dear
Fosco Servidei,
Previously, Siemens support helped us activate the Power Save mode from 12 a.m. to 6 a.m. Now I understand that day-to-day scheduling of the power saving mode is not supported, and that it only works by time.
The reactive power compensation (RPC) function sounds interesting. Do we need to purchase the R100040G4 converter to use this feature?
Thank you.
Best Regards

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0452851-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP/R4 170001840 & MP/R4170001683] Power Consumption Issue CRM:03056000045
additional_info.body:
Good evening Eng Kia,
Correct, the power saving mode can be configured and adjusted via the
OCPP parameter "PowerSavingModeSchedule" from 00:00 till 23:59, but cannot be configured differently from day to day. The setting of the time schedule of the power saving mode has to be done from the Plugz Backend.
In regards of the reactive power compensation (RPC), I apologize as I provided you with wrong information. The feature is available, but only in the Generation 2 of our Sicharge D (the so-called "Sicharge D 400"). Both the chargers mentioned by you are Generation 1 of Sicharge D, hence the reactive power compensation cannot be physically realized due to the nature of the power converters within the charger.
Please let me know if you require any further information or support. If not, I will proceed to close this ticket.
